text.p: Central Newspapers Inc, a newspaper publishing company, Thursday announced a secondary public offering of about two million of its Class A common stock priced at $64.125 per share.
The shares are being sold by the beneficiaries of the estate of Enid Goodrich, the company said.
No new shares will be issued by Central Newspapers in the transaction and the company will receive no proceeds from the sale, the company said.
The offering is expected to close Tuesday, June 24, 1997.
The underwriting group was led by Morgan Stanley Dean Witter; Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp; Merrill Lynch & Co, and PaineWebber Inc.
Central Newspapers shares were up one at 65-1/4 Thursday.
